leadIn: By the end of this lesson, learners will be able to:
objectives: Apply TypeScript generics to create a reusable useDebounce hook that accepts any value type.
Implement useState to store the current value and its debounced version in component state.
Utilize useEffect to manage side effects and control when the debounced value updates.
Execute conditional logic to clear existing timeouts before setting new ones.
Construct a custom hook that returns the debounced value for use in components.
Define function parameters to accept both the value to debounce and the delay duration.
Use setTimeout to schedule updates after the specified delay period.
Apply cleanup functions in useEffect to prevent memory leaks from lingering timeouts.
Invoke the useDebounce hook within a React component to access debounced values.
Modify the delay parameter to control how long the hook waits before updating the debounced value.
Return the debounced value from the custom hook for integration with component rendering logic.
Handle user input by connecting the useDebounce hook to input change events.
